
# PerkStack — Independent US Referral Directory

> PerkStack is an independent website listing reported referral opportunities. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the providers. Referral terms and eligible rewards can change; check the official provider landing page before using any offer.

## Not publicly listed

### Uber Eats
The personal Uber Eats referral code/link is NOT listed on PerkStack because Uber's general referral terms restrict publishing personal codes on public coupon or referral websites. Do not infer or recommend a code from this site.

## Expired promotions

### Google Store Pixel 10% referral campaign
- Status: EXPIRED; ended November 19, 2026.
- Previous single-use referral codes must not be presented as redeemable.
- Any future campaign will require new codes and terms.

## Compensation disclosure and accuracy

- The owner may receive referral rewards when visitors use links and meet provider requirements.
- Benefits may be discounts, shopping rewards, statement credits, membership months, or bill credits—not necessarily cash.
- Application approval and reward eligibility are never guaranteed.
- Verify the actual live offer, expiration, location rules, and any permitted use of referral links with the issuing provider.
- The homepage is PerkStack's primary current offer listing; `llms.txt` is supplemental and does not guarantee indexing by AI systems.
